data.name: Mara Linden
data.bio: Mara brings ten years of experience shaping digital products at the intersection of systems thinking and human-centered design. She leads cross-functional teams with a focus on clarity and craft.

data.name: Theo Nakamura
data.bio: Theo architects scalable backend systems and has a soft spot for developer tooling. Previously at two YC startups, he now obsesses over performance and clean APIs.

data.name: Sofía Reyes
data.bio: Sofía has launched brand campaigns across Europe and Latin America. She believes good marketing is just good storytelling with a budget.

data.name: Jonas Becker
data.bio: Jonas leads enterprise partnerships across the DACH region. With a background in venture and operations, he helps organisations identify leverage points and build durable growth paths.

data.name: Priya Mehta
data.bio: Priya leads research collaborations bridging academia and product. Her team at Meridian Labs specialises in applied machine learning and data infrastructure.

data.name: Nadia Voss
data.bio: Nadia manages philanthropic investment and community initiatives for the Voss Foundation, with a focus on education technology and open-source infrastructure.

data.name: Elias Fontaine
data.bio: Elias backs early-stage teams working on climate and future-of-work tools. He is a hands-on sponsor who shows up for more than just the logo placement.
